snippet.title: Gary Gadget: Building Cars (2006) Longplay
snippet.description:
All credit goes to Terje_P of Macintosh Garden for dumping this!
Download link: https://www.legendsworld.net/site/download.php?mirror=18342
Installation instructions:
1. Install VirtualDVD from OH!SOFT to bypass the game's DRM.
https://ohsoft.net/update/download.php
2. Open VirtualDVD in the system tray. Virtual Devices → (D:) No Media → Mount Image
3. Open the Gary Gadget .bin, install the game, and enjoy!

NOTE: The .bin must be mounted in your virtual drive the whole time to get it to work. Alt-Tabbing to skip cutscenes has been patched out, but the Diploma "Glitch" hasn't. Unlike the installer for "Bygg BIlar med Mulle Meck," this one is 32-bit, so it's super easy to run in Windows 10.
